title: Health Resort west wing room 205 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 205 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing room 205 key (W205 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing room 205.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Connected to room 203 through the balcony.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - Inside of the reception building at the boat launch. It sits on the ground at the base of the Drawers.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 205 of the West Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Room 205:
  - 1× LEDX spawn
  - 1× Graphics Card spawn
  - 1× Toolbox
  - 1× Medcase
  - Loose loot (Meds, Medical supplies, Provisions).
- Room 203:
  - Red keycard spawn location
  - LEDX spawn
  - 1× Weapon spawn (AR)
  - 1× Medbag
  - 1× Medcase
  - 1× Weapon box (6x2)
  - 1× Toolbox
  - 1× Sport bag
  - Loose loot (Meds, Medical supplies, Currency)
